methods.name: license.status
methods.summary: Is this install activated? Called first at every start.

methods.name: license.activate
methods.summary: First install: validate the Petra code and store it (hashed + masked copy). Offline check only.

methods.name: setup.complete
methods.summary: After activation: business details, owner + manager accounts. Allowed once.

methods.name: license.reveal
methods.summary: Show the full license code. Needs fresh owner approval token (scope license_reveal).

methods.name: auth.login
methods.summary: Login with PIN. Rate-limited: 5 wrong tries then 30 s wait (backend enforced).

methods.name: auth.logout
methods.summary: End session.

methods.name: auth.lock
methods.summary: Lock screen now (also automatic after idle).

methods.name: auth.unlock
methods.summary: Unlock with PIN of the same user.

methods.name: auth.resetPin
methods.summary: Forgot PIN: reset the OWNER PIN using the license code. Manager PIN is then reset by owner in settings.

methods.name: auth.changePin
methods.summary: Change own PIN (old PIN needed). Owner may reset manager PIN via users.setPin.

methods.name: auth.requestApproval
methods.summary: Manager (or owner for sensitive actions) enters OWNER PIN to obtain a single-use approval token, valid 2 minutes, bound to one scope. Pass it as `approval` to the next call.

methods.name: users.list
methods.summary: Users with last login.

methods.name: users.setPin
methods.summary: Reset another user's PIN (manager).

methods.name: users.update
methods.summary: Rename user, activate/deactivate manager.

methods.name: prefs.get
methods.summary: Per-user UI preferences: language bn/en, theme light/dark/system, numerals, default invoice size, calculator state, game scores.

methods.name: prefs.set
methods.summary: Patch own prefs (partial object; unknown keys rejected).
methods.notes: No audit rows for prefs (noise). Calculator history is capped at 20 entries, game scores store best score only.

methods.name: settings.get
methods.summary: Shop settings. Manager gets only keys flagged public.

methods.name: settings.set
methods.summary: Patch settings. Keys: business.*, invoice.footer, invoice.default_size, discount.require_pin_over_cap, returns.manager_needs_approval, cancel.manager_needs_approval, credit.mode(warn|block), expiry.warn_days, stock.low_default_days, lock.idle_minutes, games.enabled, games.manager_enabled, calc.enabled, commission.enabled, numerals.default.

methods.name: companies.list
methods.summary: Companies (suppliers). Manager gets id+name only.

methods.name: companies.save
methods.summary: Create or update a company.

methods.name: companies.ledger
methods.summary: Company ledger: purchases, payments, commission received.

methods.name: products.list
methods.summary: Inventory grid data. Server-side filter, sort, page. All 75..5000 rows fit one page of up to 5000.

methods.name: products.get
methods.summary: One product with lots, month-wise received vs remaining, 30-day series.

methods.name: products.save
methods.summary: Create/update one product (form).

methods.name: products.archive
methods.summary: Archive (never hard-delete a sold product).

methods.name: products.validate
methods.summary: Dry-run validation of a value before commit (grid cell).

methods.name: editmode.enable
methods.summary: Turn on manual edit mode. Owner PIN required each time; auto-off after idle/lock/logout. After 21:00-06:00 the audit row is flagged.

methods.name: editmode.disable
methods.summary: Turn off edit mode.

methods.name: grid.applyBatch
methods.summary: Atomic batch of cell edits or an Excel paste. Requires edit mode. Stock cells are converted to stock adjustments (delta + reason). Returns per-row result and the inverse batch for Ctrl+Z.
methods.audit: one audit row per changed cell (old, new, reason); stock deltas flagged

methods.name: stock.adjust
methods.summary: Explicit stock adjustment: +/- delta with reason, creates/consumes a lot (adjustment lot, unit cost = last cost).

methods.name: stock.count.submit
methods.summary: Physical count. Manager can submit counts, never fix stock.

methods.name: stock.count.list
methods.summary: Counts with expected vs counted and value of difference.

output.rows: [{count_id:id, date:date, by:string, lines:[{product_id:id, name:string, expected:Qty, counted:Qty, diff:Qty, diff_value:money}]}]

methods.name: import.pickFile
methods.summary: Open native file dialog (main process) and return a handle. UI never sees raw paths.

methods.name: import.preview
methods.summary: Parse and validate an import file (untrusted). Never writes.

methods.name: import.commit
methods.summary: Insert valid rows, skip or fix issue rows by owner resolution. Atomic.

methods.name: export.table
methods.summary: Export a table to CSV/XLSX file via save dialog. Cells starting with = + - @ are escaped.

methods.name: lots.list
methods.summary: Lots, optionally grouped. Remaining only for manager (no cost).

methods.name: purchases.create
methods.summary: Receive goods from a company: creates one lot per line, raises stock, company due. Optional payment now.

input.lines: [{product_id:id, qty:QtyIn, unit_cost:money  (per carton or per kg), received_date:date?, expiry_date:date?, pcs_per_carton:int?, sell_price:money?, retail_price:money?}]

methods.name: purchases.list
methods.summary: Purchases.

output.rows: [{id:id, no:string, date:date, company:string, lines:int, total:money, paid:money, due:money}]

methods.name: purchases.get
methods.summary: One purchase with lines and lots.

methods.name: purchases.cancel
methods.summary: Cancel a purchase only if none of its lots has been sold. Needs approval(owner PIN re-entry).

methods.name: sales.preview
methods.summary: Compute lines, discounts, FEFO lots and totals WITHOUT saving. The UI shows exactly these numbers; it does no arithmetic.

methods.name: sales.create
methods.summary: Save an invoice. Re-validates everything server-side; role and discount limits enforced here regardless of UI.
methods.notes: Single DB transaction: invoice no (gapless), lines with price/discount/cost snapshots, lot deductions (FEFO then FIFO) into sale_item_lots, ledger entry, optional payment + allocation, audit rows. Over-cap with valid approval writes discount_overrides + flagged audit row.

methods.name: sales.list
methods.summary: Invoices. Manager sees own invoices of today and the last 2 days only.

output.rows: [{id:id, invoice_no:string, ts:ts, customer:string, lines:int, total:money, paid:money, due:money, status:string, created_by:string, has_override:bool, van:bool}]

methods.name: sales.get
methods.summary: Full invoice.

methods.name: sales.cancel
methods.summary: Cancel an invoice: stock returns to the same lots, ledger reversed, payment reversal rows created. Reason required. Manager cancels flag the audit and (setting) wait for owner approval.

methods.name: invoice.data
methods.summary: Everything needed to render the invoice image/PDF. print_count increments when mark_printed is true; second and later outputs are watermarked COPY.

methods.name: files.saveBytes
methods.summary: Save rendered bytes (PDF/PNG) to the user's invoice folder or via Save dialog. Main process writes; renderer never gets a path it can reuse.

methods.name: files.share
methods.summary: Open the OS share/explorer-select for a saved file (WhatsApp Web friendly).

methods.name: printer.list
methods.summary: Reserved. Returns installed system printers and adapters; empty until adapters exist.

methods.name: printer.print
methods.summary: Reserved: send a rendered PNG to an adapter. Returns UNSUPPORTED until printers are bought.

methods.name: returns.create
methods.summary: Return request. Owner's returns apply immediately; manager's wait for owner approval (setting).

methods.name: returns.list
methods.summary: Returns. Manager sees own.

output.rows: [{id:id, no:string, ts:ts, sale_no:string, customer:string, product:string, qty:Qty, reason:string, destination:string, value:money, status:string, created_by:string}]

methods.name: returns.approve
methods.summary: Approve: good stock goes back into the original lots, damaged goes to loss; customer ledger credited.

methods.name: returns.reject
methods.summary: Reject with reason.

methods.name: customers.list
methods.summary: Shops with due, limit usage, aging.

methods.name: customers.save
methods.summary: Create (manager+owner) or update (owner only; manager may not change credit limit).

methods.name: customers.ledger
methods.summary: Ledger rows with running balance and aging buckets.

methods.name: customers.statement
methods.summary: Data for a customer statement PDF.

methods.name: customers.dueList
methods.summary: Who to chase today: due, days overdue, last payment; includes a ready reminder text (bn/en). Sending SMS is out of scope.

methods.name: payments.receive
methods.summary: RECEIVE money from a customer. Allocation default auto_oldest (oldest unpaid invoice / opening due first). Cannot exceed due unless allocation.mode=on_account (owner only, creates credit). Cheque creates a pending cheque row.
methods.notes: Gapless receipt numbers RCV-00001. Ledger credit entry + payment_allocations rows in one transaction. Manager's payments carry created_by for the day book and cash close.

methods.name: payments.preview
methods.summary: Show how an amount would be allocated, without saving.

methods.name: payments.list
methods.summary: Payments received (and for owner: paid to companies). Manager sees only own.

methods.name: payments.get
methods.summary: One payment.

methods.name: payments.receipt
methods.summary: Receipt data (58/80/A4). Render in UI like invoices; reprint is marked COPY.

methods.name: payments.reverse
methods.summary: Reverse a payment (wrong amount, bounced). Never deletes: writes a reversing ledger row, re-opens the allocated invoices, original stays visible as REVERSED. Owner PIN + reason.

methods.name: payments.dayBook
methods.summary: Collection for one day: by method, by collector, count. Manager sees own only.

output.cash_in_hand_expected: money?  (owner: cash received minus cash expenses)

methods.name: payments.cheques.list
methods.summary: Cheques with status.

output.rows: [{id:id, payment_id:id, no:string, bank:string?, customer:string, amount:money, deposit_date:date?, status:string}]

methods.name: payments.cheques.setStatus
methods.summary: Mark cleared or bounced. Bounced reverses the payment (ledger re-opens).

methods.name: payments.payCompany
methods.summary: PAY money to a company (reduces company due). Optionally allocate to purchases.

methods.name: employees.list
methods.summary: Employees with salary, advance, this-month status, 7-day sales.

output.rows: [{id:id, name:string, role:string, phone:string?, van:string?, salary:money, advance:money, paid_this_month:bool, sold_7d:money}]

methods.name: employees.save
methods.summary: Create/update employee.

methods.name: employees.paySalary
methods.summary: Pay salary, net of advance. Also creates an expense row type=salary.

methods.name: employees.advance
methods.summary: Give an advance.

methods.name: expenses.create
methods.summary: Add an expense. Append-only.

methods.name: expenses.list
methods.summary: Expenses. Manager sees own, today only.

methods.name: loadsheet.get
methods.summary: Today's van load sheet with loaded / sold / returned / expected / counted / shortage (+ value).

output.lines: [{product_id:id, name:string, loaded:Qty, sold:Qty, returned:Qty, expected:Qty, counted:Qty?, diff:Qty?, diff_value:money?}]

methods.name: loadsheet.setLoaded
methods.summary: Morning: set loaded quantities.

methods.name: loadsheet.submit
methods.summary: Evening: submit counted quantities. Shortages are flagged. Locks the sheet.

methods.name: cash.expected
methods.summary: Expected cash in hand for a date = cash received - cash expenses (opening drawer optional).

methods.name: cash.close
methods.summary: Close the day with counted cash. Difference is stored and flagged when not zero.

methods.name: cash.history
methods.summary: Past closes.

methods.name: commission.rules.list
methods.summary: Company commission rules.

methods.name: commission.rules.save
methods.summary: Create/update a rule (rates are NOT hard-coded; demo slabs 4/6/8 are sample data).

methods.name: commission.status
methods.summary: Current period: net kg (sales minus returns minus cancelled), band, estimated amount, kg to next band.

methods.name: commission.accruals.list
methods.summary: Closed periods with amount and status.

methods.name: commission.accruals.markReceived
methods.summary: Mark received (cash or settled against company due).

methods.name: dashboard.summary
methods.summary: KPI block for a range. Manager gets only own-day numbers.

methods.name: dashboard.discounts
methods.summary: Discount breakdown, grouped.

methods.name: dashboard.series
methods.summary: Time series for charts.

methods.name: dashboard.productChart
methods.summary: Per-product chart data: sales, discount, profit, stock level over time.

methods.name: dashboard.flags
methods.summary: Red flags: over-cap discounts, cancellations, returns, stock adjustments, count diffs, load-sheet shortages, cash differences, after-hours edits, clock moved back, payment reversals, bounced cheques.

methods.name: dashboard.alerts
methods.summary: Low stock, out of stock, near expiry.

methods.name: audit.list
methods.summary: Append-only audit log.

methods.name: audit.verify
methods.summary: Walk the hash chain. Returns first broken id if tampered.

methods.name: backup.list
methods.summary: Local backups (newest first) with size, counts, verified flag, drive status.

output.rows: [{id:string, ts:ts, bytes:int, products:int, invoices:int, verified:bool, drive:enum(none|queued|uploaded|failed)}]

methods.name: backup.create
methods.summary: Backup now (verify after write). Also runs automatically every N minutes, on close, and before restore/migration.

methods.name: backup.restore
methods.summary: Verify then restore. Takes a safety backup first. App restarts the DB handle.

methods.name: drive.status
methods.summary: Google Drive: connected account, online, queue length, last upload.

methods.name: drive.connect
methods.summary: Start OAuth (system browser, loopback redirect, PKCE). Verify current Google desktop OAuth rules at implementation time.

methods.name: drive.disconnect
methods.summary: Forget tokens.

methods.name: drive.uploadNow
methods.summary: Upload queued backups now (needs net).

methods.name: system.info
methods.summary: Versions and paths for the About box.

methods.name: system.clockCheck
methods.summary: Detect system date moved backwards since the last write. Called at start and hourly.
methods.notes: When not ok the backend writes a flagged audit row and the UI shows a banner.

methods.name: cash.reopen
methods.summary: Preserve close, open a new revision.

methods.name: cash.preview
methods.summary: Read-only close preview.

methods.name: returns.preview
methods.summary: Cumulative refund entitlement.

methods.name: purchases.preview

input.lines: [{product_id:id, qty:QtyIn, unit_cost:money  (per carton or per kg), received_date:date?, expiry_date:date?, pcs_per_carton:int?, sell_price:money?, retail_price:money?}]

methods.summary: Purchase totals before saving.

methods.name: payments.refund
methods.summary: Refund customer credit; never negative credit.

methods.name: payments.applyCredit
methods.summary: Allocate available credit without changing ledger balance.

methods.name: expenses.reverse
methods.summary: Compensating correction on open business day.

methods.name: returns.reverse
methods.summary: Compensating correction on open business day.

methods.name: employees.reverse
methods.summary: Compensating correction on open business day.

methods.name: backup.import
methods.summary: Validate external backup selected by native dialog.

methods.name: opening.import
methods.summary: Opening ledger balances; once per party.

methods.name: products.aggregate
methods.summary: Compatible-unit totals, role safe.

methods.name: loadsheet.reopen
methods.summary: Preserve submitted revision and reopen.

methods.name: groups.save
methods.summary: Explicit product group.

methods.name: groups.list
methods.summary: Product groups.

methods.name: loadsheet.list
methods.summary: Recent van trips (load sheets) with totals

events._how: window.api.on(name, cb) -> unsubscribe fn. Main process pushes, payload is small.
